text: わたしが　いままでに　みた　すっごく　おおきい　ヘラクロス…　＊ｃｍ

structure.jp: わたしが　いままでに　みた
structure.en: that I've seen up to now

structure.jp: すっごく　おおきい　ヘラクロス…

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わたしが　いままでに　みた　すっごく　おおきい　ヘラクロス
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed in front of a thing word describes it, like 'that I saw'. わたしが　いままでに　みた　ヘラクロス = 'the Heracross I've seen so far'.

patterns.name: 〜までに
patterns.explanation: までに means 'by' or 'at some point up to' a time. いままでに = 'up to now, so far'.
